from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, identifying itself and citing other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cited_papers_in_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the collection metadata) that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
